sources.entry: Centrifugo - Language-agnostic real-time messaging (Websocket or SockJS) server. (Demo, Source Code) MIT Go/Docker/K8S

summary.one_liner: Centrifugo is a scalable, language-agnostic real-time messaging server that delivers channel-based pub/sub messages to connected users over WebSocket, SSE, HTTP-streaming, GRPC and WebTransport.
keywords: push data to users from backend
summary.what_it_does: Centrifugo sits between an application backend and its end users, delivering messages to clients connected over WebSocket, HTTP-streaming, Server-Sent Events, GRPC and WebTransport (experimental). The backend publishes messages into named channels through a simple HTTP or GRPC API, and clients subscribe to those channels, using official SDKs or a unidirectional approach without an SDK. It supports channel subscriptions with stream, map, shared poll and proxy models, plus presence information with join/leave notifications. Message history allows automatic recovery after reconnects, and a cache recovery mode delivers the latest publication on subscribe. Scaling is provided by Redis (including Cluster and compatible stores), PostgreSQL or NATS, and connection authentication can use JWT or a proxy-style request to the backend. An embedded admin web UI and Prometheus metrics are included.
use_cases: add live comments to a website
stream AI responses to users in the browser
push real-time updates from a backend to connected clients
power multiplayer game or collaborative tool messaging
how_to_run: docker run -it --rm -p 8000:8000 centrifugo/centrifugo:latest centrifugo --client.insecure --admin.enabled --admin.insecure (local trial only)
Install native binaries, Homebrew or packages per the official installation instructions
Follow the official quickstart tutorial to connect a first client
notable: Language-agnostic: any backend talks to it over HTTP or GRPC API
Multiple transports including WebSocket, SSE, HTTP-streaming, GRPC and WebTransport
Message history with automatic recovery on reconnect and delta compression based on Fossil
Official client SDKs for JavaScript, Dart/Flutter, Swift, Java, Python, Go and C#
Embedded admin web UI for watching connections and publishing messages
caveats: Quick start Docker flags disable authentication and are for local trial only
WebTransport support is marked experimental and the .NET/MAUI/Unity SDK is marked WIP
Scaling beyond a single node requires an external store such as Redis, PostgreSQL or NATS
